lines.say: For years, revision plans have broken the moment real life happens.
Upload your notes and your exam dates.
Everything's built from your own notes. Flashcards, blurting, and exam-style questions.
First you learn it, then it tests you, then it keeps it in your head.
Connect your Google Calendar, and it plans around your lectures and shifts.
Miss a day, and it moves the work, and tells you what moved.
Offload. A study system that adapts when real life happens.
